description: Get the full snapshot for ONE option contract by its OCC symbol (e.g. O:AAPL260724C00110000): greeks, implied volatility, open interest, the latest daily price, the previous traded session, the latest print, and bid/ask with sizes and exchanges when the plan entitles quotes. Last, day range and volume name the provider's trading-session timestamp when supplied and otherwise mark it unknown; open interest names its separate effective date when supplied; implied volatility and greeks are model values computed at fetch time (* marks ones computed from the quote) and can differ slightly from a chain response. Bid/ask use consolidated real-time OPRA on Pro and a 15-minute delayed indicative feed on Plus; the Free plan covers end-of-day data only and is answered with an upgrade note. For a TSX/TSXV listing or an NSE share or index pass MIC:TICKER, e.g. XTSE:RY, XNSE:NIFTY. Plus and Pro get the exchange's bid/ask, IV and OI in its currency; greeks are computed on XTSE/XTSX only.

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, or MIC:TICKER for a TSX or TSXV listing or an NSE share or index, e.g. XTSE:RY, XNSE:NIFTY
